detail: Full summary: the .twining/ path pattern recently added to scoreDecisionDocumentation in src/scenarios/conflict-resolution.ts is dead code — it is tested against transcriptC.fileChanges, which by construction never contains a .twining/ path because data-collector filters them into infrastructureFileChanges. The twining_record tool-call branch of that same fix does work, so no score is wrong, but the file-path half pins nothing. NOT fixed here — the task forbade modifying existing scorers.
